MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the closest match because my DVI cable purchase shows that connecting displays is sometimes a practical need for me, although I would still need a specific HDMI connection to make.",
    "Offering a connection accessory recognized part of my interest in making existing equipment work together."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices, Echo Dot and smart plug do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my purchases; I have no current streaming or home automation project.",
    "Buying a tablet tripod mount does not imply that I need to mount a television, and owning a headset does not give me a reason to buy earbuds or a speaker.",
    "The SD card would only be useful if I had a compatible device needing storage, which my recent purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treated an interest in computer accessories as an interest in household electronics generally.",
    "They stretched shared words or broad functions, such as mounts and audio, beyond the specific equipment and purpose behind my purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, and my earlier Wi-Fi adapter and USB expansion card also point toward practical computer connectivity needs.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart and serve specific purposes. Even a relevant accessory is unlikely to interest me without a concrete need and the right connections."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my interest in connection accessories but extended it into entertainment and smart-home purchases I have no current reason to make."
}
